District Belagavi for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 302 read with Section 34 of IPC are before this Court under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

3. FIR in Crime No.317/2022 was registered by Kakati Police Station, District Belagavi for the aforesaid offences on the complaint dated 24.12.2022 lodged by the Fakeerappa Bheemarayi Varaga,
who is the father of deceased Smt. Gouramma.
In the complaint, it is averred that the marriage of deceased with the 1st accused was solemnized in the month of February-2019 and the couple have a boy child from the wedlock.
After the marriage, the accused persons were ill-treating and torturing the complainant's daughter-Smt.Gouramma in her NC: 2024:KHC-D:528 matrimonial house.
This was informed by the deceased to her parents who had pacified her.

On 24.02.2022 at about 1.00 p.m., when the complainant was in his village he was informed that his daughter was murdered by her husband and her in-laws in their house and thereafter had hanged the dead body of deceased in the bedroom.
Immediately, the complainant and his relatives went to the spot and found the dead body of Smt.Gouramma, which was hanged in the bedroom of her matrimonial house.
It is in this background, a complaint was lodged on 24.02.2022 at about 23:00 hours, based on which FIR in Crime No.317/2022 was registered by Kakati Police Station.
4. During the course of investigation, the petitioners herein were arrested on 03.01.2023.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet is filed.
Petitioners are arrayed as accused Nos.1 and 2 in the charge sheet.
Their bail application filed before the Court of Court of V Additional Sessions Judge, Belagavi in Criminal NC: 2024:KHC-D:528 Miscellaneous No.509/2023 was rejected on 01.06.2023.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition, submits that the case of prosecution is based on the circumstantial evidence.
The postmortem report would go to show that the death was as a result of asphyxia due to hanging.
The bedroom, in which the dead body of deceased was found, was locked from the inside and therefore the allegation made in the charge sheet against the petitioners are false.
Petitioners have no criminal antecedents and they are agriculturists by avocation.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
6. Per contra, the learned High Court Government Pleader has opposed the petition.
She submits that feet of the dead body was touching the ground and therefore, it is evident that the petitioners had murdered Smt.Gouramma.

In the complaint, which had resulted in registering FIR in Crime No.317/2022 against the accused, allegation is that the accused had murdered the deceased and thereafter had hanged her dead body in the bedroom of the house.
The postmortem report of deceased does not reflect any grievous injuries on the body of the deceased.
The final report issued by the Department of Forensic Science Laboratory with regard to the cause of death states that death is due to asphyxia as a result of hanging.
The spot mahazar would go to show that the room in which the dead body was found was locked from inside.

Merely for the reason that the feet of the deceased was touching the ground,
it cannot be said that the accused had committed the murder of deceased.
The Police have not recorded the statement of immediate neighbourers of the accused persons.
There is no material available on record to show that on the date of incident the accused persons had assaulted the deceased or they had quarreled with her.
All the witnesses who have been examined by the Police speak about the ill-treatment meted out on the NC: 2024:KHC-D:528 deceased by the accused after the marriage.
But they do not speak about any incident that had taken place on the date of death of the deceased.
The petitioners who have no criminal antecedents are in custody from 03.01.2023.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet is filed.
Allegation against the petitioners is required to be proved in a full-fledged trial.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that the prayer made for regular bail is required to be answered in the affirmative.

Accordingly the following:
ORDER Petition is allowed.

The petitioners are directed to be enlarged on bail in S.C.No.156/2023 pending before the Court of V Additional District and Sessions Judge, Belagavi arising out of Crime No.317/2022 registered by Kakati Police Station,
District Belagavi for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 302 read with Section 34 of IPC, subject to the following conditions:
i.
